text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with only a single week remaining 
until the start of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Pant*, *pant*... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I compared her split times to previous 
data. 
...Having confirmed that she had 
distinctly improved, 
I spoke.
choice_data_list:
Let's challenge her again. Narita Brian, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
That is what I wanted to hear.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sitting around with time to 
kill. 
Don't keep calling me out like this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. —Yet, rest assured. 
I shall not summon you again after this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For from this moment on, even if only by a 
fingertip, 
I shall reach you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Well, your fiery spirit is the 
one thing 
that hasn't changed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Other things have, however. 
I shall show you. On the turf.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis & Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph!" 
"Haaaaaaahhhhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis had weapons right from the 
start. 
One of them was her intense 'fighting 
spirit.'

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't merely that she fell short. She 
felt as though 
she had been told she would never catch up 
in her lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —How thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Phalaenopsis & Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Yaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!" 
"...! Haaah!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And now, as a result of tempering her 
mind, 
she had gained 'patience.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was something she had always possessed, 
but in the heat of a race, it was eclipsed 
by her 'fighting spirit' 
and remained unexpressed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet now, having learned to wield both 
fighting spirit 
and patience at once, she—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without breaking her pace from the start, 
she saved her legs—and the instant she hit 
the final stretch, 
she was able to ignite her fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, in terms of sheer ability, 
Narita Brian 
still stood far beyond her reach. Yet, 
knowing full well that was the case, 
Phalaenopsis—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ran like a sharpened blade, focused solely 
on 
a single moment: overtaking her right 
before the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'patience' to hold out until the 
moment to strike, 
and the 'fighting spirit' to tear through 
the rival battling beside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed with both, Phalaenopsis was now— 
truly and thoroughly prepared.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*... Ngh! 
Ah, how vexing...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet—she had sunk her teeth into her 
throat.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
She had not managed to tear it open just 
yet, but... 
she had earned the right to speak not of 
resignation, but of bitter regret.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Wouldn't you agree, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. As if. 
You're not ready yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still... hmph. 
Call me when you've gotten stronger than 
you are now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Then I'll face you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, you have always been so easy to 
read. 
Such an uncharming... yet endearing one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the Oka Sho finally 
arrived. 
Her club companions had also rushed to the 
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Phalaenopsis is really running in 
the Oka Sho today... Oh man, I'm getting 
so nervous!

text_block_list.name: Club Female Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're not the one running, are you? 
Though as a fellow club member, I 
completely understand.

text_block_list.name: Club Female Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...Good luck, Phalaenopsis! All we can do 
is cheer 
for you, but our hopes are riding on you!

text_block_list.name: Club Members
text_block_list.text:
"Just run like you always do and you've 
got this!" 
"Go for it!" "Do your best!" 
"You can do it, Phalaenopsis, I know you 
can!!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I thank you for your support. 
Without fail... most certainly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I will live up to all your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I call out to the club staff member, who 
is already tearing up. 
Flustered, he wipes his tears and answers.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! She hasn't even run yet, and 
here I am... 
Yet today, I felt a sudden, absolute 
certainty.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That in the Oka Sho... she will 
surely 
bring victory home to our club.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text: ...Just look at her, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some wagashi. 
It will help take your mind off things.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
! ...Wait, 
why are you the one soothing my nerves?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Why, because I have long been prepared. 
Rather, it is all of you who must 
ready yourselves for the race.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It would not do for you to miss the moment 
I claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Ph-Phalaenopsis...!

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...She has grown so much, both in body and 
mind. 
She was always wise beyond her years... 
but now, 
she carries a commanding presence backed 
by true strength.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. 
For guiding Phalaenopsis this far.
choice_data_list: ...No, it's far too early to say that!

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, indeed. 
You're quite right.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
We have high hopes! 
For what the two of you will achieve 
today!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. 
Time for the first crown.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to tell you beforehand. 
There is no need for you to cheer for me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is quite simple. 
You have known all along, have you not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—The simple truth that the crown of cherry 
blossoms belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Just stay by my side and bear witness. 
To the triumph you have won.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall be off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......You held on to me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you don't run an embarrassing 
race.
